name: Hoshimi Miku
source: The youngest sister, she is a very mischievous troublemaker who is considered a trouble child by her sisters. She is a whimsical girl who is often compared to a cat. A member of the tennis club, Miku is considered one of the candidates for the team's regular members. Often butts heads with her oldest sister, [url=/c46478]Asuka[/url], whom she also loves teasing. Gets along better with [url=/c46479]Yuki[/url], whom she calls affectionally "Yukkii".
